scope: cols contains a complete snapshot WRITER - the reference implementation for the open encoder work

top_level_writers: player_frame_with_world(server_time, command_time, origin, establish_baseline, equipment, angles, world)
block_writers: glass.rs, props.rs, impact.rs, animal.rs, helicopter.rs, ... (one writer per block)

why_it_matters: we have been hand-crafting the snapshot bit stream with partial knowledge; cols already contains a complete, working encoder for the 3.3.3.3 generation
its player_frame_with_world shows the whole block sequence with explicit validation of every field, which is exactly the semantic information our encoder lacks
the formats differ by generation, so it cannot be copied verbatim - but it is the reference to port the missing pieces from (playerstate fields, actors payload, glass)
next: read player_frame_with_world's body far enough to extract the ordered list of blocks and the playerstate field order it writes
compare that order with the 1649370 field table (0xDA63E8) to map cols field names onto our offsets
that mapping is what turns our 'unknown semantics' into a concrete porting task
